description: This file provides utility functions for managing plugin runtime overlays, including creating symlinks, copying files, wrapping and staging plugin code, and managing node_modules directories within a build system.

methods.name: symlinkType
methods.description: Determines the type of symlink to create based on the operating system (junction for Windows, directory for others).

methods.name: relativeSymlinkTarget
methods.description: Computes the relative path from the target directory to the source path for symlink creation.

methods.name: ensureSymlink
methods.description: Creates a symlink at the target path, overwriting it if necessary, and handles existing symlinks.

methods.name: symlinkPath
methods.description: Creates a symlink from source path to target path, using the relative path.

methods.name: shouldWrapRuntimeJsFile
methods.description: Checks whether a JavaScript file should be wrapped based on its extension.

methods.name: shouldCopyRuntimeFile
methods.description: Determines if a file should be copied based on its filename, typically configuration files.

methods.name: writeRuntimeModuleWrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapper module that re-exports and imports the original module, facilitating runtime overlay.

methods.name: stagePluginRuntimeOverlay
methods.description: Recursively stages a plugin directory by wrapping JavaScript files, copying config files, and creating symlinks for other files.

methods.name: linkPluginNodeModules
methods.description: Creates a symlink to the plugin's node_modules directory within the runtime plugin directory.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntime
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the staging of plugin runtimes, handling directory setup and overlays.
